description: Curated METHOD knowledge objects for the TensorFEM side of the method axis. A method is only listed when its implementation path exists in src/ (the compiler hard-fails otherwise), so a METHOD KO can never point at a module that was removed.

methods.title: Mindlin-Reissner plate with consistent shear integration
methods.applicability: Thick-to-moderately-thin plate bending under transverse load; carries transverse shear so a/t down to ~20 is admissible.
validity_limits: Below a/t ~ 10 the element must be shown free of shear locking on the ladder cases.
Transverse shear correction factor is a modelling choice, not a measured quantity.

methods.title: 4-node MITC4 shell (assumed transverse shear strain)
methods.applicability: General thin-shell stiffened-panel and hull plating response including buckling preload paths.
validity_limits: Membrane/shear locking at coarse meshes must be checked against a reference rung.
Flat-facet geometry: curvature error is O(h^2) in the facet approximation.

methods.title: Timoshenko beam (shear-deformable) for modal and static response
methods.applicability: Beam/girder idealisation with shear deformation; modal frequencies of slender ship structures.
validity_limits: Euler-Bernoulli limit recovered only as h -> 0; report both.
Thin, very slender members may show reduced-order shear over-stiffness.

methods.title: Corotational large-deflection beam
methods.applicability: Elastica-range cantilever tip deflection where linear theory over-predicts by >5%.
validity_limits: Finite-rotation range only; no plasticity coupling inside this module.
Path following needs arc-length control beyond the first limit point.

methods.title: Augmented-Lagrangian unilateral contact
methods.applicability: Hertz-type indentation and ice-structure contact patches with non-penetration constraints.
validity_limits: Contact patch resolution must resolve the contact radius; under-resolved h/a is reported as a modelling error, not a solver error.
Friction law is a modelling assumption unless separately calibrated.

methods.title: Cohesive zone model (3D interface elements)
methods.applicability: Delamination and debonding of layered/stiffened assemblies.
validity_limits: Dissipation must be mesh-objective; check the dissipated energy against the analytic DCB value.
Cohesive stiffness is a numerical parameter that must not change the peak load.

methods.title: J2 (von Mises) elastoplasticity with implicit tangent
methods.applicability: Ultimate-strength and plastic-collapse checks of grillages and indented panels.
validity_limits: Limit-point and post-peak response require arc-length control to be trustworthy.

methods.title: Steady/transient heat conduction with L2 projection error measure
methods.applicability: Thermal field of polar/plate structures feeding thermoelastic stress.
validity_limits: The L2 norm must be measured against the interpolant of the exact solution, not the exact solution itself (see the norm-measurement defect).

methods.title: Immersed boundary FSI with Aitken dynamic under-relaxation
methods.applicability: Added-mass-dominated fluid-structure sub-iteration where a fixed relaxation factor stalls.
validity_limits: Aitken convergence is a property of the interface operator; report the sub-iteration gain, not just 'converged'.
Added-mass ratio beyond the tested band is unverified.
